services.desc: Welcome to Main Street Midway, where fun and friendly competition come to life! Challenge your friends and family to exciting games like Long and Short Range Basketball, Whac-A-Mole, Goblet Toss, and Balloon Busters. With so many thrilling activities to try, who will take home the title of ultimate champion? The games are waiting-are you ready to play? Lead your own starship battle group into a deep-space shootout of cataclysmic proportions. Dance, Dance, Dance ‘til you drop. Horseracing, snowboarding, big time sports-whatever you can imagine is a virtual reality in the Game Room. We prioritize the safety and comfort of your family.
